source: User-provided Cloudflare Speed Test screenshot submitted with the public Wi-Fi scenario sample; screenshot retained in the repository.

networkCondition.scenarioContext: Submitted in response to a request for public/free Wi-Fi evidence; access point type and actual default route are not independently verified.

comparisonNote: Keep separate from the same-turn sp01IdentityProbe application-roundtrip report. Cloudflare and CloudBase are different targets and metrics; screenshot indicators alone do not establish which access point or route carried the test.
interpretation: One Cloudflare result in the reported public-Wi-Fi scenario shows the listed link measurements. The screenshot displays both Wi-Fi and 4G indicators; it does not independently identify the public access point, device, default route, or Pakomo/VPN state. Do not treat its 0% packet-loss display as zero loss on CloudBase or as a stable public-Wi-Fi profile.
